# SpektraLab pinned source

Source: https://github.com/JamesQiu2005/SpektraLab

Revision: `6a347d5756f8b1a96ec393c60bf5d0452fa5498b`, retrieved 2026-10-11.

`upstream/` contains 117 selected, unmodified original files needed for the portable core, pipeline, Vulkan backend, profiles, constants and licenses. `source-manifest.json` records each original's bytes and SHA-256. Reference build scripts, test programs and user databases are not included or executed.

Original code license: `upstream/license/LICENSE` (GNU GPLv3). Original spektrafilm data: Andrea Volpato, `upstream/license/SPEKTRAFILM_LICENSE.txt` (CC BY-SA 4.0). Volk has its own preserved license.

See [local changes](CHANGES.md) and [Android integration](../../docs/engineering/film-engine.md). Source integration has not been compiled or exercised on Android.
